{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the 'revenue' column
print("Unique values in 'revenue':")
print(data['revenue'].unique()[:10])  # Show first 10 unique values

# Check for thousands separators
print("\nSample of 'revenue' values:")
print(data['revenue'].sample(5))

# Check if any revenue values contain commas
has_commas = data['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any()
print(f"\nAny revenue values contain commas? {has_commas}")"}
